name: Trail Runner
description: A low-profile trail running shoe with a matte-coated clay-orange and charcoal-grey ripstop mesh upper, synthetic overlays, and a chunky lugged rubber outsole built for off-road traction.
materials: matte-coated ripstop mesh upper, synthetic overlays, chunky lugged rubber outsole
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, tag, patch, or embroidered/printed/embossed lettering anywhere on the shoe; never render the outsole lugs as smooth or the mesh as glossy leather Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: keep the outsole lug pattern chunky and off-white (never bright white or grey) and keep the mesh and overlay construction consistent across every angle, entirely free of any marks or lettering When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
